sentences.text:
Petitioners, through the medium of this petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, have prayed for the following reliefs:-
I) To direct and commanding respondents to conclude the acquisition proceedings in respect of land measuring 7 Kanals 17 Marlas covered under Khasra No. 130 and 157 situated at Village Kenu Tehsil Mandi District Poonch and pay compensation to the petitioners for the land which was acquired for construction of Mandi Phagla Road at Village Kenu under Central Road Fund Scheme Tehsil Mandi District Poonch.
II) To direct and commanding respondents to initiate fresh acquisition proceedings under 'The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013' and finalize the acquisition proceedings immediately, and pay the compensation for the land taken over by the respondents for construction of Mandi Phagla Road at Village Kenu under Central Road Fund (CRF) Scheme in Tehsil Mandi District Poonch, measuring 7 Kanals situated at Village Kenu Tehsil Mandi District Poonch as per prevalent market value along with 18% interest from the date of occupation till its realization.
02.

sentences.text: Pursuant to notice, objections have been filed by the revenue authorities, particularly, the concerned Collector Land Acquisition stating therein that the indenting department has neither released nor placed the requisite funds at the disposal of the answering respondents for issuance of the final award, as such, final award has not been issued, with the further stipulation that the land acquisition proceedings carried out under J&K Land Acquisition Act have been lapsed and the indenting department had neither requested for revival of the proceedings nor raised the fresh indent under 'the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013' before the Collector.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 03. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in view of the stand taken by the Collector this petition can be considered to be disposed of at this stage to issue a direction to the Collectorate concerned for proceedings in terms of the new applicable Act of 2013 instead of the old local Act which is not relevant, after the time has elapsed before the final award to be passed.
His statement is taken on record in support of his contention.

04. Mr. Monika Kohli, learned Senior AAG appearing for the respondents No. 1, 3, 5 & 8 and Mr.
Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG appearing for the respondents No. 2, 4, 6 & 7 submit that the respondents have no objections to the plea raised by the learned counsel for the petitioners with regard to consideration by the local Collectorate to proceed in the matter in accordance with law which may be applicable for the acquisition of the land measuring 7 Kanal 17 Marlas comprising of Khasra No. 130 & 157 situated at village Khenu Tehsil Mandi District Poonch for construction of Mandi Phagla Road at village Kenu under Central Road Fund (CRF) Scheme and prayed that an appropriate orders be passed.
05.

In view of the pleadings in the file and the submissions urged at the Bar on both sides, this petition is disposed of at this stage with a direction to the respondent No. 5 to proceed in the matter Liyakat Ali Khan Age 56 Years vs Union Territory Of Jammu & Kashmir ... on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23227996/
